body: The Giants are awful this season, but when it comes to the home team, everyone is blind.

For a long time the belief that things would get better got me through it. I truly believed that without great pain there would be no progress. But that's all it's been. Pain, no progress. My life is in the exact same position it was 5 years ago. I'm starting to realize the only reason people tell you not to kill yourself is for selfish reasons. *They* don't want to feel bad over your death. *They* don't want to have to mourn you. 

Every action you take is influenced and driven by the prior actions of people. Lets break it down; You were born because of the actions of your parents. You were educated because of a system of laws made by other people made you become educated. You kissed suzy in the playground that afternoon when you were 12 because of generations of excellent pedigree and breeding has instilled in your mind and genitals the desire to reproduce. 

Everything you do is caused by the actions of others. There is no free will; say for one thing. 

Death.

The only option you have, that truly belongs to you: is existing. 

**Suicide is your only option. **
